codex_note:
## Codex adaptation boundary

This mirror uses the native Codex project-local skill root `.agents/skills/verify-<app>/`. It discovers the real surface from the repository, selects the proof path through proof-orchestrator, and respects the selected model and effort through model-capability-router. The native verification runner is required for a verified result. If the harness or startup is missing, preserve the project and report `blocked`. Generation never installs a global skill, publishes an artifact, opens a PR, kills by process name, or changes product code. The example harness commands in the feature-map references are upstream examples and must be replaced by concrete commands observed in the target repository before a generated skill is used.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, "make a control skill for this repo", or when a project has no scripted way to prove UI/CLI/service behavior.
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic renderer are static provenance. Focused tests render the held candidate into a temporary project-local fixture and exercise positive, unavailable-harness, and malformed-input outcomes.
reason: The adapter changes the generated destination and tool boundary while leaving the pinned upstream source unchanged.
